description: 1 x internally illuminated digital advertising display banner
decision_conditions: The proposed advertisement would lead to increased risk to pedestrians and other road users through its siting, design and potential distraction to vehicle drivers, resulting in an adverse effect on the safety of pedestrians and other road users. The proposals are therefore contrary to Havering Local Plan 2016-2031 Policy 23, London Plan Policies Policy T2, T4 and D8 which each fundamentally require the public realm to be safe as well as the objectives of TR3 of the NPPF.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to the agent in writing 9 October 2026.
